newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow Vnukovo airport closes runway for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Moscow Vnukovo airport closes runway for repairs.

text.p: Vnukovo airport closed one of its two runways on Monday for repair work until August 1, a senior aiport official said.
Nikolai Dubovitski, deputy head of Vnukovo airport, told Reuters that the landing and lighting system on the runway would be replaced with a more modern system.
"At the airport there will be work as usual during these two months...without any flights postponed," he said, adding that all airlines which use Vnukovo had been told about the runway's closure.
Vnukovo is the second largest of four Moscow airports, and operates mostly domestic flights. It also operates some international scheduled and charter flights.
